    if not c:
        return 0
    return len(c)

def classify_by_length(l):
    if l == 0:
        return "空白 (0字)"
    elif l < 100:
        return "极短 (<100字)"
    elif l < 500:
        return "短 (100-500字)"
    elif l < 2000:
        return "中等 (500-2000字)"
    elif l < 5000:
        return "长 (2000-5000字)"
    else:

length_dist = Counter([classify_by_length(l) for l in lengths])

    '调研', '链接', '备忘录'
]

for title in titles:
    for kw in keyword_patterns:
        if kw.lower() in title.lower():
            keywords.append(kw)

kw_counter = Counter(keywords)
print("\n=== Title Keyword Frequency ===")
for kw, cnt in kw_counter.most_common(30):
    print(f"  [{cnt}] {kw}")

# === 6. Quality Classification ===
print("\n=== Quality Classification ===")

def classify_quality(note):
    title = note.get('title', '')
    content = note.get('content', '')
    note_type = note.get('note_type', '')
    tags = note.get('tags', [])
    is_ai = note.get('is_ai_generated', False)

        if note_type == 'img_text' or any('图片' in title for _ in [1]):

        return 'quick_note'

    if is_ai and note_type == 'link' and content_len > 2000:

    if content_len > 3000:

for n in notes:

    if ct:
        try:

print("\n=== Monthly Distribution ===")
